InterMaths is an Erasmus Mundus joint master in mathematical modelling and simulation with applications in biomedical sciences and industrial engineering, coordinated from the University of L'Aquila. The 2026 scholarship round closed on 25 February at 13:00 CET, and the 2027 round is expected to use the same date, giving maths applicants a relatively late deadline.

Programme Highlights

  • Applied mathematics programme with biomedical and industrial modelling tracks
  • Late-February scholarship deadline — useful for applicants still gathering documents
  • Double-degree structure across consortium universities
  • Foundation semester available to homogenise competencies before the main curriculum

Who Should Apply

Mathematics and applied mathematics graduates (physics and engineering applicants with strong maths are also considered); a short teaching or research statement forms part of the file.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students: tuition coverage plus a monthly allowance.

Deadline and How to Apply

Submit through the InterMaths online tool before the late-February cut-off and check the consortium's news page for the official 2027 announcement. Key deadline information: 25 February 2027 (13:00 CET, scholarship round, expected — the 2026 round closed on this date and time).
